note: A1 is an undriven DAC output pin sampled by a normally running capture - loop mode feeds DAC0 only. A0 carries a 1 kHz 1.5 Vpp sine for scale. vpp is per 4000-sample window, the span the Measure panel works on. MEASURE_MIN_SWING_CODES is 10; not one of 1240 quiet windows came in under 45.
